title: 🗣️ حوار مهارات كتابة المقال والتراث (Speaking & Writing Dialogue - SB Page 22)
description: 💡 حوار بين الطالبين كريم (Karim) و عمر (Omar) حول إعداد مقال أكاديمي بعنوان Where Pride Begins: Inspiring Figures & Egyptian Heritage لتقديمه في مسابقة المدرسة السنوية.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Omar (عمر)
turns.en: Hi Karim! Have you started writing your essay for the school competition about Egyptian heritage?

turns.speaker: ✍️ Karim (كريم)
turns.en: Yes, Omar. I decided to focus on inspiring Egyptian figures and where true national pride begins.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Omar (عمر)
turns.en: That sounds wonderful! How are you organizing the three main parts of your essay?

turns.speaker: ✍️ Karim (كريم)
turns.en: I started with an engaging introduction ending with a clear thesis statement. Then, each body paragraph begins with a topic sentence and provides evidence.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Omar (عمر)
turns.en: And what about the conclusion? How will you conclude your arguments?

turns.speaker: ✍️ Karim (كريم)
turns.en: I restated the thesis statement in different words and summarized that young people must take responsibility for building the future while honoring our roots.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Omar (عمر)
turns.en: Excellent advice! That is a well-structured essay. Best of luck in the competition, Karim!
